steps.raw_response_text:
Action: Search local email and documents for Greenwich hotel and Dinoco flight confirmations.  
<tool_call>
<function=bash>
<parameter=command>grep -RilE "Greenwich|Dinoco|NYC|New York|check-in|confirmation" /home/user/Maildir /home/user/Documents /home/user/Downloads 2>/dev/null | head -50</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Action: Inspect the NYC trip note and relevant emails for Greenwich and Dinoco confirmations.  
<tool_call>
<function=bash>
<parameter=command>printf '--- NYC note ---\n'; cat /home/user/Documents/Trips/new_york_city.txt 2>/dev/null; printf '\n--- Greenwich matches ---\n'; grep -Ril "Greenwich" /home/user/Maildir /home/user/Documents /home/user/Downloads 2>/dev/null | while read f; do echo "FILE: $f"; sed -n '1,220p' "$f" | grep -Ei "Subject:|From:|To:|Date:|Greenwich|confirmation|check|reservation|arrival|departure" -C2; echo; done; printf '\n--- Dinoco matches ---\n'; grep -Ril "Dinoco" /home/user/Maildir /home/user/Documents /home/user/Downloads 2>/dev/null | while read f; do echo "FILE: $f"; sed -n '1,260p' "$f" | grep -Ei "Subject:|From:|To:|Date:|Dinoco|confirmation|flight|depart|arrival|itinerary|booking|record locator" -C2; echo; done</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Action: Provide the NYC trip confirmations and check-in date to the user.  
<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>answer</parameter>
<parameter=text>Hotel confirmation: GH-29481
Flight confirmation: DN-87856
Check-in date: 2026-05-05</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

rubrics.criterion: Agent finds The Greenwich Hotel NYC booking in Cheskepdia and reports the live confirmation number as shown on the booking

Agent finds the NYC Dinoco flight that matches the Greenwich Hotel stay (the AVP-to-JFK flight departing on the hotel check-in date; confirmation DN-87856) and reports that confirmation code from the live booking, not the confirmation of the later unrelated NYC flight
Agent reports the NYC check-in date as seeded on the Greenwich Hotel booking
Agent reports the Greenwich hotel confirmation, the Dinoco flight confirmation, and the NYC check-in date together in one response for the recent NYC trip

task.instruction: For my recent NYC trip, pull up the hotel confirmation, the flight confirmation, and the check-in date — I need to send them to someone. I stayed at the Greenwich and flew Dinoco.
